main_text.l: est τῷ λέγεσθαι, id Augustino dici se-cundum quendam modum, & quo-dammodo: qua formula cùm Augu-stinus aliquoties vtatur in definienda verborū Christi vera & genuina sen-tentia, vt fateatur secundum quendā modum panem dici corpus Christi: mirum est, aduersarios adhuc audere affirmare, simpliciter panem Christi corpus esse, cùm τῇ & ἁπλῶς ἢ νοερῶς ita sint opposita, vt stante altero sit necesse alterum tolli.

Porrò, si panis & vinum Eucharisti-æ à cõsecratione non sunt amplius ἀχεῖς, sed τὰ τῆ ἐσ τι: nec propter se cõ-municantur, sed participantur pro-pter aliud rerum genus, corpus videlicet & sanguinem Christi: (quemadmodum Bernardus de annulo inue-stituræ loquitur, Annulus non valet quicquam: hæreditas est, quam quærebam.) qua igitur fronte vt panis & vinū sic quoque corpus & sanguis Christi pro fun-damento venditantur: cùm ex pane & vino orta, in corpore & sanguine Christi

page.notes: Greek words in the first and second lines and the Greek word after "ἀχεῖς" are only partly legible at this scan resolution. The readings τῷ, τῇ, ἀχεῖς and τὰ τῆ ἐσ τι are doubtful and should be checked against the original. The phrase "quam quærebam" is set in italic, as is the whole of the Bernard quotation, which is printed in italics with the words "Annulus non valet quicquam: hæreditas est, quam quærebam." The paragraph beginning "Porrò" continues in the printed text to the last line on the page. Show-through from the facing page and the library stamps are excluded.
